description:
Recommend which Vira product fits a business need in Peru.

    `problem` is the need in plain words, English or Spanish (e.g. "I need to issue invoices valid in Peru",
    "my WhatsApp gets more messages than I can answer", "track fruit lots for EUDR", "I lose stock and don't know
    where"). `business_type` is optional (e.g. "pharmacy", "agro-exporter", "hardware store", "distributor").
    Returns up to three matches with what is free to start, the next step and a contact link.
name: vira_recommend_solution
title: Recommend a Vira solution for a business problem
